daily.topThemeTitle: AI Moves From Adoption to Stewardship
daily.topThemeBody: EdTech Digest argues classroom AI's next phase is about stewardship rather than adoption, echoed by EdTech Magazine's look at AI-powered observation and analytics tools that give teachers an extra set of eyes on student progress.

heroWeek.themeTitle: Washington Weighs In, Leaves Room for Nuance
heroWeek.themeBody: The Department of Education's new edtech guidance sets a purposeful, outcomes-driven bar but defers rulemaking to states, while EdTech Digest finds the screen-time debate growing more nuanced rather than settling on blanket bans.
